title: Study Comparing Osteoarthritis Programs
official: Evaluation of the Integrated Mindfulness Walking (I'M Walking) Program for Older Primary Care Patients With Knee Osteoarthritis
summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if a behavioral program called I'M Walking will help with pain in middle-aged and older adults.

* Does the program improve pain interference in participants with knee osteoarthritis?
* What other factors may affect pain interference with participants that did the intervention?

Researchers will compare the I'M Walking program with a Walk With Ease program (self-directed program)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥50 years
* Community-dwelling
* ICD-10 codes for knee Osteoarthritis in electronic health record
* Moderate to severe chronic pain using Graded Chronic Pain Scale-Revised (PEG score ≥4)
* Knee pain-related difficulty with walking or climbing stairs
* Owns a smart phone

Exclusion Criteria:

* Dementia (ICD-10 codes in EHR or T-MoCA score\<13)
* Unable to independently walk a quarter mile
